goNoGo.rule: Recheck Met Éireann marine warnings and Sea Area Forecast at Friday and event-day gates.
Reliable visual control of paddlers and support craft is required.
Safety Lead/skipper signs off current wind, gusts and direction.
Verify Teelin, Killybegs-sector and receiving-coast extraction before launch.
Current chart, stream, swell and visibility must support a controlled safe-water line.
No exposed leg without functioning safety-cover system.
VHF Channel 16 plus redundant emergency communications required.
Verify first aid, hypothermia equipment and AED plan.
Complete accountability and route/abort briefing before launch.

routeOptions.name: Malin Beg → offshore clearance → Bullockmore West Cardinal → Bundoran
routeOptions.description: Clear the launch/coastal headland influence, then use the shortest practical water chords rather than tracing bays. Bullockmore remains the shared St John's control reference; actual offing remains under skipper/current-chart judgement.

routeOptions.name: Bullockmore → Mullaghmore → Bundoran alternative
routeOptions.description: Operational concept retained, but its plotted geometry is hidden until the alternative route is independently water-audited.

routeOptions.name: Malin Beg → Killybegs / Fintra shortened event
routeOptions.description: Northern shortened-finish concept. Geometry remains under review rather than showing a misleading chord.

routeOptions.name: Malin Beg → Teelin early finish
routeOptions.description: Teelin remains an early extraction concept. Geometry remains under review rather than showing a misleading coastal chord.

waypoints.name: Silver Strand / Malin Beg
waypoints.note: Exact water-entry point is an event-day decision.

waypoints.name: Malin Beg launch clearance
waypoints.note: Initial seaward clearance from launch/coast before taking the shortest available water chord.

waypoints.name: Outer coast clearance
waypoints.note: Maintains offing from the first coastal/headland sector without following the bay contour.

waypoints.name: Outer headland-clearance gate
waypoints.note: Once clear of coastal/headland tidal influence, cut the minimum-distance water chord toward Bullockmore rather than tracing Teelin/Muckross bays.

waypoints.name: Teelin Pier
waypoints.note: Primary early bailout/support rendezvous; not a required touchpoint on the optimized primary line.

waypoints.name: Muckross Head planning reference
waypoints.note: Reference only for the optimized primary line; the route deliberately passes well offshore rather than steering toward the headland.

waypoints.name: Bullockmore West Cardinal
waypoints.note: Retained as the shared St John's control reference. Approach with generous sea room; do not steer toward the headland apex simply to touch a waypoint.

waypoints.name: St John's Point lighthouse
waypoints.note: Headland reference. Primary line remains offshore; exact sea room is selected from current conditions/chart.

waypoints.name: Mullaghmore Harbour
waypoints.note: Alternative control/extraction point; alternative geometry under review.

waypoints.name: Bundoran outer approach
waypoints.note: Transition from the open-bay chord to the final Boat Quay approach without turning toward the receiving coastline too early.

timeline: Malin Beg launch inspection and kit issue
Route, formation, comms and abort triggers
Start only with all hard checks resolved
Condition/pace check; early exit remains available if required
Confirm group is clear of the northern headland/coastal influence before committing to the long chord
Minimum-distance receiving-coast chord; pod integrity and rolling checks
hazards: Avoid close-in apex lines; select tide window and maintain sea room.
Bullockmore / St John's shoals and rocks
Mandatory charted gate; no improvised inside line.
Close pod formation, escort craft, VHF, PLB and headcounts.
No launch/abort if reliable visual control is lost.
Thermal system, PFD/BA, rapid recovery and dry/hypothermia kit.
Fuel/hydrate on schedule and use exits before technique deteriorates.
accessAed: Verify exact community AED cabinet and launch access before event.
Primary early extraction point; verify AED cabinet.
Verify exact vehicle and shoreline extraction arrangement.
Verify water depth/access for selected window.
Finish command-post candidate; emergency activation remains Coast Guard/VHF16.
